statements.quote: For the additional 70 MW expansion, Core Scientific is responsible for funding $104 Million of capex ($1.5M per MW) for the powered core and shell with no capex credit associated with this new agreement.
statements.notes: The sentence states capex for the 70 MW CoreWeave high-density colocation expansion. It does not itself say 'AI'. The AI link comes from p01, which describes converting facilities for AI-related workloads under these contracts. The sentence describes a funding commitment with no period stated, so it is recorded as an outlook with no fiscal year. The separate ~$750 Million build-out figure in p04 is funded by CoreWeave, not the company, so it is excluded. Total Q1 2025 purchases of property, plant and equipment ($88.4 million, p02/p05) appear only in the cash-flow tables with no AI link, so they are not recorded.
